title: Tool error
description: structuredContent of a failed MCP tool call (isError: true). dayhand turns it into its own error on stderr (error.schema.json).

code.description: invalid_argument, not_found, unauthenticated, precondition_failed, conflict, agents_paused, forbidden, approval_required, rate_limited, internal (values may be added; treat an unknown code like internal)

retryAfterMs.description: Only with rate_limited: milliseconds until the key may call again

approvalId.description: Only with approval_required: the approval request the call waits for; once the owner allows it, repeat exactly the same call with approvalId (since 0.11.0)
